verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a consumer mobile one-time-passcode generator that works offline and syncs codes through a Google Account. It exposes no service or API surface, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack mentions only app UI features, HOTP/TOTP implementations and a PAM module, with nothing about versioned APIs or deprecation policies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
